_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obras" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "cliente" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ubicacion" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fecha_inicio" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activa" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activa" IN (0, 1)), "cotizacion_origen_id" TEXT NULL, "pdf_config_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "puestos" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "salario_dia_default" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "colaboradores" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "puesto_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo_pago" TEXT NOT NULL, "telefono" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contacto_nombre" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contacto_telefono" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "contacto_parentesco" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "activo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activo" IN (0, 1)), "salario_personalizado" REAL NULL, "periodo_pago" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MENSUAL', "salario_periodo" REAL NULL, "dias_semana" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 6, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obra_colaborador" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "obra_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "colaborador_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_ingreso" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fecha_salida" INTEGER NULL, "salario_dia_override" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("obra_id", "colaborador_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asistencias" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "colaborador_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "obra_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fraccion" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("colaborador_id", "obra_id", "fecha"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "destajos" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "colaborador_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "obra_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "concepto" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cotizaciones" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cliente" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre_proyecto" TEXT NOT NULL, "ubicacion" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BORRADOR', "iva_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("iva_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "descuento" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "notas" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "obra_id" TEXT NULL, "pdf_config_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "secciones" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cotizacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "orden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "partidas" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "seccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clave" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "descripcion" TEXT NOT NULL, "unidad" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cantidad" REAL NOT NULL, "precio_unitario" REAL NOT NULL, "orden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pagos" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cotizacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "monto" REAL NOT NULL, "metodo" TEXT NOT NULL, "concepto" TEXT NOT NULL, "referencia" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movimientos" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "obra_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoria" TEXT NOT NULL, "concepto" TEXT NOT NULL, "monto" REAL NOT NULL, "metodo_pago" TEXT NOT NULL, "referencia" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "nomina_id" TEXT NULL, "cotizacion_id" TEXT NULL, "seccion_id" TEXT NULL, "partida_id" TEXT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalogo_conceptos" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clave" TEXT NOT NULL, "descripcion" TEXT NOT NULL, "unidad" TEXT NOT NULL, "precio_unitario_default" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "categoria" TEXT NOT NULL, "es_personalizado" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("es_personalizado" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "archivos_cotizacion" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cotizacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "uri" TEXT NOT NULL, "fecha_agregado" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "obra_presupuesto" ("empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_updated_at" INTEGER NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "obra_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "concepto" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "unidad" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "cantidad" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0, "precio_unitario" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "orden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
